key_insight: POD-CNF combines proper orthogonal decomposition with conditional normalizing flows to learn parameter-dependent solution distributions for stochastic PDEs, including multimodal outputs.
engineering_relevance: The surrogate enables efficient uncertainty quantification for high-dimensional physical systems and offers a route toward Bayesian inverse modeling.
method: Compress solution snapshots into low-dimensional coefficients using proper orthogonal decomposition.
Train a conditional normalizing flow to model coefficient distributions given input parameters.
Sample reduced coefficients and reconstruct approximate solution fields.
evidence_signal: Numerical experiments demonstrate accurate output-distribution reproduction with substantially reduced computational costs, alongside a proof-of-concept Bayesian inverse application.
watch_item: The abstract does not quantify speedups or establish robustness outside the training parameter range.
paper_title: POD-CNF: reduced order modeling of parametrized stochastic PDEs via normalizing flows and proper orthogonal decomposition
